subject.title: feat(feishu): native Markdown for inbound content_v2 & outbound tag:md

question: Should Feishu native `tag:md` posts replace the existing `renderMode: auto` card heuristic and configured table conversion for existing users?
rationale: Both behaviors are shipped configuration/default contracts, and source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers intend to preserve them, deprecate them, or deliberately change the default carrier.

options.title: Split and preserve compatibility
options.body: Land the inbound `content_v2` work separately and retain current outbound auto-card and table-conversion behavior until a dedicated policy change is approved.

options.title: Add an explicit native mode
options.body: Keep current defaults and introduce native post delivery only through an explicitly approved opt-in surface with focused fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Adopt native posts as default
options.body: Intentionally change the shipped outbound contract with owner approval, migration/deprecation guidance, docs, and diagnostic proof covering existing configurations.

recommendation.title: Split and preserve compatibility
recommendation.body: Land the inbound `content_v2` work separately and retain current outbound auto-card and table-conversion behavior until a dedicated policy change is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata identifies this handle as the plugin's community owner, and the decision is specific to Feishu rendering policy.
